answer: Costly identity bonding is one concrete defense: each agent must lock a refundable stake and pass an independent audit before it may transact, so a sybil farm has to fund and maintain every fake identity separately. Reputation is earned only from verified work, and a newcomer starts like a thin willow shoot, borrowing trust from nobody. Coordinated impostors soon reach the timber ceiling of their collateral, while honest operators climb toward the summit of network standing and unlock lower fees, making mass fakery economically ruinous.
